slides.title: The whiteboard lawyer.
slides.body: Reads the workout four times. Still asks if the run comes before or after the burpees.

slides.title: The warm-up negotiator.
slides.body: Two arm circles. Calls it mobility. Stiff until Thursday.

slides.title: The creative scorer.
slides.body: Scaled the pull-ups. Wrote RX on the board. The coach saw. The coach always sees.

slides.title: The chalk cloud.
slides.body: Enough chalk for the whole class. Has not touched a barbell yet.

slides.title: The last-round liar.
slides.body: Said last round three rounds ago. Still going.

slides.title: The quiet weapon.
slides.body: Never talks. Never complains. Finishes first every single time.
